title: Artifact Model Schema
description: Validates the value object for each entry in templates/<variant>/procedures/_output-types.yaml. Enriches artifact type definitions with contracts: owner, format, fields, evidence binding, and retention policy. See design §7.1 and ADR-0083.

description.description: Human-readable description of the artifact type.

owner_agent.description: Kebab-case agent identifier that owns/authors this artifact type. Must resolve to a real agent file or a human-role registry entry (templates/<variant>/governance/_human-roles.yaml). DEG-A-03 requires every owner_agent to be resolvable.

format.description: Primary output format of this artifact type. 'mixed' indicates multiple formats within one artifact instance.

type.description: Field type: string, number, boolean, array, object, or a domain-specific type name.

required.description: Whether this field is mandatory in every artifact instance.

fields.description: Optional array of field definitions. Specifies the structure of the artifact data.

evidence_model.description: Optional path under evidence-models/ that defines the evidence schema for this artifact type (e.g. 'evidence-models/_shared/tbm-record.json'). Null if no evidence model is bound. DEG-A-04 requires a non-null evidence_model for retention: regulated.

retention.description: Retention policy: session (transient), engagement (duration of engagement), permanent (archival), or regulated (subject to regulatory retention rules). If regulated, evidence_model must be non-null.
